stageNotes: Stage 1: apex doctordeals.ca returns 202+sgcaptcha; www also 202. Canonical apex confirmed via <link rel=canonical> after Playwright bypass.
Stage 2: heavy 8-batch probe — every path returns 202 with SG-Captcha header. No cf-ray. No Sucuri. sgcaptcha confirmed. Playwright iPhone UA clears the challenge.

Stage 3: body.class contains woocommerce-js + theme-flatsome; meta generator AIOSEO (SEO plugin not platform — Mistake 22/39 noted). /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products returns 200 + valid WC payload — WooCommerce confirmed.

Stage 4g: 3 sample products extracted with title+url+stock from .product-small cards (Flatsome theme). Price resolved via WC Store API enrichment at runtime.
Stage 5: /shop/page/N/ form; page1 vs page2 zero-overlap verified (12+12 distinct slugs). perPage=12 (Flatsome default, no <select> override exposed in HTML).

Stage 6: 3-outcome counter-control. default first3 == ?orderby=date first3 (date IS the default); ?orderby=price first3 distinct -> verdict honored-default-is-newest. sortParam=?orderby=date sortVerified=true.
Stage 7: WP REST two-probe — ?after=2099-01-01 returns x-wp-total=0; ?after=1999-01-01 returns x-wp-total=971. WC Store API same: 0 vs 582. api-date-since-watermark honored. Method A selected.

Stage 8: WP REST /wp-json/wp/v2/product per_page=1 returns x-wp-total=971; product-sitemap.xml has 971 <loc> entries (exact match). WC Store API customer-visible total = 582 (in-stock subset). Picked WP REST (admin) as canonical because it matches sitemap and covers full inventory including OOS.
